|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target's ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 67. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Slip Sliding Away (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) added “(if 'hit,' character is first restored to normal)” at the end: “Cancel Path Of Least Resistance. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your move phase, target opponent's character at an interior Cloud City site. Draw destiny. Relocate target to Weather Vane if destiny > target's ability. OR Relocate your character at an interior Cloud City site to Weather Vane (if 'hit,' character is first restored to normal).”.<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38, page 38. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=38 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 1 August 2013, with its ruling on Weather Vane and Into The Ventilation Shaft, Lefty<ref name="pcforum-p825184">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 1 August 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p825184 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then (the Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014).
